plan_item: P-88 (A1-numerics): k_max / truncation-shape convergence of route-B DDO154 at fixed source and fixed parameters
status: PREREGISTERED_BEFORE_ANY_RESULT. No case below has been run. Thresholds, gates and the decision rule are fixed here and must not be changed after any result exists; a change is a new version (V002) with the reason recorded.

G3.role: G2 panels unchanged + one outer panel [2,3] per side, order 6 (same width and order as the existing [1,2] panel)

composite_grid_spec.scope: Seed V002 twelve panels to 2/kpc bitwise unchanged plus outer panels [-3,-2],[2,3] order 6; full signed cube; k_max convergence test P-88 only; no continuum or cutoff error certificate.

G4.role: G3 + one more outer panel [3,4] per side, order 6

composite_grid_spec.scope: Seed V002 twelve panels to 2/kpc bitwise unchanged plus outer panels [-4,-3],[-3,-2],[2,3],[3,4] order 6; full signed cube; k_max convergence test P-88 only; no continuum or cutoff error certificate.

GR.role: inner-refinement control: G2 breaks, the 10 panels inside |k|<=1/kpc raised from order 6 to 8, outer [1,2] panels unchanged

composite_grid_spec.scope: Seed V002 breaks to 2/kpc; inner ten panels order 8, outer [1,2] panels order 6; inner-refinement control for P-88 only; no continuum or cutoff error certificate.

fixed_across_all_cases.physical: identical block in every case (default: seed V002 values, s=1, entropy_K_factor=64/121, 4.04 Mpc, 66 deg; or copied verbatim from the production A2 base call spec)
fixed_across_all_cases.brackets: identical rule block in every case (default: the CALL_REPRO_RULE_FULL_C2V001 rule incl. its declared overrides; or copied verbatim from the production base call spec)
fixed_across_all_cases.observation: column-mean V004 rows (HI-weighted mean of R*Omega, binding f42c7c65...)
fixed_across_all_cases.what_fixed_source_means: Observed Sigma, fixed analytic stars, the sigma0=11 km/s K0 rule and the 64/121 entropy factor are fixed. The gas state is re-solved self-consistently in every case (that is the forward map calibration will use). Route A (and so K0, body, roots) is cube-truncated at each case's grid edge by driver design (INTERFACE_C2_0466 s5); K0 drift between grids is reported, not hidden.

criterion.tau_definition: tau = 0.25 * sigma_min (rows 06-08, quoted random sigma 0.2 km/s); applied as an ABSOLUTE bound to every row
criterion.relative_equivalent: tau/v_i: about 4.3e-3 on row 01 (v~11.6 km/s) to 1.0e-3 on rows 10-11 (v~50 km/s); reported alongside, not used for the decision
criterion.statistic: D_A(K1,K2) = max over the 12 rows of |v_i(A,K2) - v_i(A,K1)| in km/s, A in {cube, sphere, cylinder}

per_case_validity_gates.V1: driver status COMPLETED, valid true, exactly the 12 registered row ids with finite speeds
per_case_validity_gates.V3: normalized_spec matches the registered case (grid breaks/orders, shape, kmax) and the common block (physical, coefficients sha, entropy, picard, brackets) is identical across all cases; same driver sha in all cases
per_case_validity_gates.V4: final field packet wavevector axis equals the registered grid axis bitwise (prep formula) and holds axis_nodes^3 nodes
per_case_validity_gates.V5: final field packet rows outside the registered mask are exactly zero, and the kept-node count equals the count from the registered grid
per_case_validity_gates.V6: admitted cases: route-A identity_sha256 equals that of the cube case they admit

criterion.shape_pass: Pass(A) iff cases (A,2),(A,3),(A,4) are valid AND D_A(3,4) <= tau AND D_A(3,4) < D_A(2,3) (contracting)
decision_rule: 1. Any case needed by a step below is invalid -> INCOMPLETE (name the case and failed gate; rerun that case only).
2. D_R > tau_inner -> INNER_UNRESOLVED (next step: raise inner panel orders on the adopted grid; needs a prep node budget > 96).

3. No shape passes -> NOT_CONVERGED (next step: extend the shape with the smallest D_A(3,4) to 5 and 6 /kpc with the same order-6 unit outer panels, 108/120 nodes per axis; needs a reviewed prep successor with budget >= 120 and a per-call cap >= 6 GiB).
4. Two or more shapes pass but some pair differs at K=4 by more than tau_shape on any row -> NOT_CONVERGED (SHAPE_DISAGREEMENT; same next step).
5. Otherwise ADOPT A* = the passing shape with the smallest measured m4 ratio at K=4 (driver azimuthal_harmonics global_max m4; tie within 10% -> smaller D_A(3,4)), at k_max = 4 /kpc on grid G4.
6. Carried numerical uncertainty per row: u_i = |v_i(A*,4) - v_i(A*,3)| + |v_i(R) - v_i(C2)| km/s, reported with the adoption.
why_tau: Measured Picard floor of the saved chain is 0.0095 km/s (pass 2->3); tau must sit well above it to be decidable (tau/floor = 5.3); the per-case Picard gate tau/4 = 0.0125 keeps iteration error below a quarter of tau.

A uniform 0.05 km/s bias moves every row by at most 0.25 sigma_min, i.e. <= 8.7% of the half-width of the frozen 12-row Bonferroni band (z = 2.865), and adds at most 0.75 to a 12-row chi-square even if every row had sigma_min.
It is below the carried A1-m>=1 indicator range (0.5*eps2*v = 0.015-0.272 km/s), so numerics do not dominate the declared sensitivity budget.

An absolute bound tied to sigma_min is used rather than a uniform relative bound because the calibration compares km/s residuals against sigma; a uniform 1e-3 relative bound would permit 0.05 km/s at the outer rows but demand 0.012 km/s at row 01 (near the Picard floor).
